exposed_dft_features.name: Read Status (70h) / Read Status Enhanced (78h)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Per-LUN error reporting (FAIL, FAILC, CSP) — built-in observability for Program/Erase/Read outcomes.

exposed_dft_features.name: Read Parameter Page (ECh) with CRC + 3 redundant copies
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Built-in self-checking of factory metadata; host CRC validation surfaces media-bitline errors.

exposed_dft_features.name: Read Unique ID (EDh) + complement
exposed_dft_features.purpose: 16-copy self-validating UID retrieval — bit-flip detection without host bookkeeping.

exposed_dft_features.name: Read DQ Training (62h, NV-DDR3)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Functionally a built-in lane DFT — fixed device-driven pattern lets the host bench-characterize per-DQ RX eye.

exposed_dft_features.name: Write TX DQ Training (63h pattern / 64h readback, NV-DDR3)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Round-trip pattern check — directly observes the write-path eye margin.

exposed_dft_features.name: Write RX DQ Training (76h, NV-DDR3)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Device-side RX training; observable indirectly via subsequent Read Status.

exposed_dft_features.name: ZQ Calibration (F9h / D9h)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Output-driver impedance trim against external RZQ — built-in process/voltage/temperature compensation.

exposed_dft_features.name: Implicit DCC Training (18h, NV-DDR3)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Internal clock duty-cycle correction — required for high-speed eye margin.

exposed_dft_features.name: Get Features (EEh)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Round-trip of programmed feature settings (timing mode, drive strength, ODT, training values).

exposed_dft_features.name: Factory Defect Map (Section 3.3)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: First byte of spare area of first/last page of each bad block ≠ FFh — host-visible bad-block markers.

exposed_dft_features.name: Composite Status (Table 102)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Multi-plane operations OR per-plane FAIL bits into the Read Status (70h) composite byte — host gets a single fast pass/fail check.

fields.no_jtag_on_package: ONFI 4.1 does NOT specify a JTAG / boundary-scan / scan-chain port on the NAND package interface. All vendor DFT (scan, BIST, charge-pump trim, sense-amp characterization) is performed at wafer / package test before shipment and is not visible to the host via ONFI commands.
fields.notes: ONFI exposes substantial protocol-level observability (status bits, CRC-protected parameter page with redundancy, UID with complement, NV-DDR3 training commands) plus high-speed-PHY characterization hooks (Read DQ Training, Write TX/RX DQ Training, ZQ / DCC calibration). However, there is no formal DFT / JTAG / scan port on the package edge. Internal NAND-cell health (raw bit-error rate, ECC headroom, charge-pump margin) is reported only indirectly — via FAIL bit on Program / Erase, CSP threshold on EZ NAND Read, and host-side UBER measurement (Uncorrectable Bit Error Rate, Section 1.4.1.30).
